description: This file defines a CMake function 'GetExternalCode' that manages retrieving source code from a remote Git repository during the build configuration process. It handles cloning repositories, checking out specific versions, and managing local source directories.

methods.name: GetExternalCode
methods.description: A CMake function that clones a Git repository, optionally checks out a specific version, and manages the local source directory, supporting parameters like GIT_REPOSITORY, GIT_VERSION, SOURCE_DIR, and FORCE.
